saints.name: The Exaltation of the Holy Cross
saints.title: Feast of the Holy Cross
saints.shortBlurb: The Church lifts up the Cross of Christ, the instrument of shame made the tree of life and victory…
biography: This feast celebrates the Cross by which Christ redeemed the world. It is bound to two events at Jerusalem: the dedication in 335 of the basilica built by Constantine over Calvary and the Holy Sepulchre, near which St. Helena is said to have found the True Cross, and the recovery of the relic of the Cross by the Emperor Heraclius in 629 after it had been carried off by the Persians.

On this day the Church venerates the Cross not as a sign of defeat but of triumph — the throne from which Christ reigned, the tree whose fruit is salvation. It is kept as a feast throughout the Church.
saints.knownFor: The triumph of Christ's Cross, the tree of life.
